summary.text: Jason Guidone is the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Catherine Osten (D / Working Families Party / Independent Party of Connecticut).
He won the August 11 Republican primary over Mike France and was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Guidone graduated from Xavier High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Southern Connecticut State University in 1998.
Guidone lost the 2024 general election for District 19 to Osten, 56.9 percent to 43.1 percent.
In the 2026 Republican primary he defeated France, 56.2 percent to 43.8 percent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he supports responsible spending, transparency in government, and policies that keep taxes under control.
He also said he strongly supports police and first responders and favors strong parental involvement and local control of education decisions.
